description: Na₃Sc₂(PO₄)₃ is Esseneite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.67 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.89 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted pentagonal planar geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.59 Å. There are two inequivalent Sc sites. In the first Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.16 Å. In the second Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.17 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-43°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-43°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-45°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom.
